scenes.narration: GitHub just added a way to test your Copilot skills and MCP tools.
scenes.visual_description: Bold title card on dark background: three simple icons (skill, agent, plug) feeding into a checkmark box. Self-made, no logos.

scenes.narration: AI output can change from one run to the next.
scenes.visual_description: One prompt box with three arrows to three slightly different answer cards.

scenes.narration: So one good answer does not prove your skill, agent or MCP tool works.
scenes.visual_description: Single green answer card highlighted, with a question mark over the other cards.

scenes.narration: That is why evals exist. An eval is a repeatable test for AI behavior.
scenes.visual_description: Word EVAL appears with a looping arrow icon labeled repeat.

scenes.narration: You give an agent a realistic task, describe what a good result looks like,
scenes.visual_description: Two stacked cards: Realistic task, then What good looks like.

scenes.narration: and check the result and how the agent got there.
scenes.visual_description: A path of dots leading to a result box, both getting checkmarks.

scenes.narration: In Copilot Evals, you ask Copilot in your own words, or use the slash eval command.
scenes.visual_description: Two entry arrows labeled Plain words and /eval merging into one box labeled Create eval.

scenes.narration: You approve each run, then see which checks passed and failed.
scenes.visual_description: Approve button shape, then a checklist with some ticks and one cross.

scenes.narration: Change your skill, rerun the same eval, and compare before and after.
scenes.on_screen_text: Rerun after you change a skill
scenes.visual_description: Two checklists side by side labeled Before and After with a compare arrow.

scenes.narration: It is in public preview, for Individual, Business and Enterprise plans. What would you test first?
scenes.visual_description: Badge reading Public preview over three plan labels, then follow prompt text.
